provenanceNote: The alias/label enumeration is generated programmatically from templates/states.yml (the declared cross-system source of truth), never hand-typed. The capitalised-Turkish-İ, bolded-status, and empty/dash-to-Discarded cases are copied verbatim from the existing, verified tests in web/src/lib/status-alias.test.mjs (see each case's `note`). Every case here corresponds to an assertion that file already makes and CI already runs.
matchRule: A conforming implementation's canonical-status resolver, given `input`, must resolve to the state whose id is `expectedId` (equivalently: whose label, uppercased, is a SUBSTRING of the resolver's return value — this mirrors the `.includes()` contract status-alias.test.mjs itself asserts against, not exact equality, because the JS implementation's return value is a token like "EVALUATED" that is not always byte-identical to the label).
